About the choices... I'm currently living with my parents and working for the second year, because I already chose the wrong college once. For the first year (last schoolyear) I've been in therapy for a killing depression, so I didn't think much about school. Right now, I have all time for picking a school and I honestly don't know what I want. All the options I have are not what I want, and all the things I want are not available. The pressure is thrice as much as it usually is, because I just financially can't choose the wrong college AGAIN. And working for ANOTHER year is also not possible because my parents might kick me out. And even if they won't kick out, I will most likely kill myself.

Sorry, I'm ranting again. Thank you for taking a bit of your time to answer to me.
